description: evidence.nu base detection silently failed: (1) git log --grep pattern 'fabro.<run-id>:' never matched checkpoint subjects 'fabro(<run-id>): ...' because a regex '.' ate the '(' and the pattern lacked the ')' before ':' — use --fixed-strings with literal 'fabro(<run-id>):'; (2) run_id from 'parse --regex | get -o id' is a list<string>, interpolating it into a string renders '[id]' — use 'get -o id.0'. Symptom: NO RUN BASE, empty diff sections, misleading evidence.
resolution: Fixed both in evidence.nu: fixed-string grep + id.0 cell path; smoke run detects base 805acb3 and emits the real 192-line run diff
